messages:
Sam: FYI noticed a small eviction ripple in us-east1-c ~03:03 UTC, ~45 pods evicted in ~90s. Not the big storm but noisy.
OpsBot: alert: cluster.evictions.rate spiked from 0.2->6.8 evicts/min in us-east1-c at 03:03:12
Ritu: saw the rack-sweep job kicked off at 03:02:58, it tainted racks to consolidate low-util racks (taint: rack-sweep=true:NoSchedule)
Sam: the evicted pods look mostly low-req gpu-burst jobs (ai-batch-small-*), many with RequiredDuringSchedulingAffinity against team cohosts
Diego: logs show drain used `kubectl drain --force --delete-local-data` which bypasses eviction API/PDBs -> instant hard kills
Priya: that's the key. PDBs were ignored so kubelet did eviction fallback. Also saw a surge of Pending pods stuck because nic conntrack on warm nodes hit nf_conntrack_max -> SYN drops
Ritu: small-slot fragmentation after sweep left many 0.25GPU slots scattered across racks; scheduler tried aggressive preempt to pack but preempt jitter was minimal so multiple preempts overlapped
Sam: scheduler snippet:
```
I0412 03:03:05 scheduler.go:512] fit failed: PodAffinity conflict with ai-batch-small-7
I0412 03:03:05 scheduler.go:515] preempting pod ai-batch-small-3 on node-9
I0412 03:03:06 scheduler.go:520] eviction API returned error: PDB violation, falling back to force delete
```
Diego: conntrack / CNI churn explains some lease ack timeouts too. calicoctl stats show conntrack drops rising at 03:02:50
Priya: short-term mitigations I propose:
- pause rack-sweep job for 30m (prevent repeated fragmentation)
- revert `--force --delete-local-data` -> use `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data=false` + eviction API so PDBs honored
- bump nf_conntrack_max on warm nodes to 1.6x and roll node-exporter probe for conntrack-drops
- enable scheduler `preemptionJitter=200ms` and `preemptBackoff=30s` in canary
Ritu: will patch rack-sweep to respect pods disruption budgets and switch to eviction API, filing PR now
Diego: I'll spin 6 extra warm nodes in us-east1-c for 20m to buy time for the patch
OpsBot: rack-sweep job paused by Ritu for 30 minutes. Reason: emergency fragmentation/eviction mitigation.
Sam: long-term actions:
- make rack-sweep tolerant to small-batch pods: convert strict required affinities to preferred for jobs tagged `batch:small` during drains
- add anti-storm throttle: if >Y taints applied in AZ in Z minutes, convert drains to sequential with min-gap
- add scheduler metric alert: if preempt attempts per minute > 10 and eviction rate > 5/min -> throttle preempts
Priya: also want a runbook note: avoid `--force` in scheduled drains; if you must, annotate job with `infra/allow-force=true` and require 2-person approve
Ritu: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/patch/rack-sweep-pdbs (draft)
Sam: nice. monitoring team, please verify conntrack probe, eviction-rate, and preempt-attempts dashboards get thresholds updated.
Diego: rolling status: evict rate down to ~1/min after pause and extra nodes up. watching nodes for conntrack drops.
Priya: filing followup INFRA-2244 to track affinity-relax automation + drain-safety defaults
Sam: thanks all — keep messages short in-thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
